description: Read-only: return an embedded TouchDesigner operator workflow guide with common inputs, outputs, examples, next-operator suggestions, and snapshot provenance. When an operator is absent from the imported snapshot, returns candidate guide ids and an explicit snapshot caveat instead of claiming that the operator does not exist.

include_examples.description: Include Python examples, expressions, and generated usage patterns.

next_limit.description: Maximum number of next-operator suggestions to return.

operator.description: Operator name, display name, or slug to look up.

name: get_operator_workflow_guide

data_version.description: Import source, source version, timestamp, and covered TouchDesigner version.

examples.description: Operator examples, when requested and available.

found.description: True when the embedded knowledge base has a workflow guide.

lookup_status.description: Whether the operator is present in the imported knowledge snapshot.

operator.description: The operator string from the request.

snapshot_notice.description: Caveat attached when an operator is absent from the imported snapshot.

suggestions.description: Candidate operator ids when no exact guide is found.

title: Get operator workflow guide
